content:
ellie: Quick UX nit — the prompt-length error toast currently says `Error: prompt too long`. It feels cryptic and doesn't guide the user. Can we pick better microcopy? :thinking:
sam: Agree. Especially for novices, 'prompt too long' doesn't say what to change or where the limit is. Could we show the limit or point to docs?
mohit: Also a11y note: toast dismisses after 3s and isn't announced properly by screen readers. We should ensure it's in an ARIA live region and consider slightly longer display for errors.
jess: Copy options (short, medium, long) — leaving tone friendly and actionable:

1) Short: "Prompt exceeds length limit. Shorten your input or split into multiple requests."
2) Medium: "Your prompt is too long for this workspace (limit: 8,192 tokens). Try shortening the prompt or use multiple requests. Learn more →"
3) Long: "We couldn't process your input because it exceeds your workspace's prompt size limit (8,192 tokens). To continue, shorten the prompt, remove unnecessary context, or split into smaller messages. See guidance in our docs to optimize prompts."

design-bot: [automated] Current toast text: `Error: prompt too long` — severity: error — code: PROMPT_TOO_LONG — suggested retention: 3s
mohit: I prefer option 2 but with an inline action. Instead of full 'Learn more →' we could render a subtle 'View limits' link that opens the quota modal (better than sending to docs). Also change retention to 7s and announce aria-live="assertive".
sam: +1 for showing the numeric limit. If limits are tenant-configurable, show the configured value, otherwise show 'your workspace limit'. We should also make sure server responses include the actual token count so UI can show something like "8,500 / 8,192 tokens".
ellie: API note — we often return 413/REQUEST_TOO_LARGE with header X-Token-Usage. If we standardize the header `X-Used-Tokens` and `X-Token-Limit` we can populate the toast. I'll follow up with backend about adding those when available.
jess: Accessibility copy tweak: avoid parentheses in the audible message. For screen readers, option 2 becomes: "Your prompt is too long. Your workspace limit is 8,192 tokens. Shorten the prompt or split it. View limits."
mohit: Also propose micro-interaction: if we detect a paste that pushes over the limit, show an in-place inline helper under the input box (red text) rather than just the toast. Toast should be fallback for API-level rejects.
ellie: Action items: 1) I'll update the copy to option 2 + 'View limits' link and prepare accessibility phrasing. 2) Mohit, can you adjust toast lifetime and aria-live? 3) Sam, can you coordinate with infra on the token headers? I'll put a tiny mockup in the PR.
jess: Great — if we keep concise language + actionable step + limit value, should reduce support tickets. :thumbsup:
ellie: I'll post the PR later today with the text variants and a screenshot. Thanks all!
